For Archlin, Demand Planning is the defined Phase 1 scope. The blueprint therefore focuses on the demand planning processes and related solution design elements needed to support Archlin’s planning transformation. Demand Planning is referenced in the source definitions as DP, and related supply chain planning terminology includes Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Sales & Operations Planning, Forecast Item, New Product Introduction, End Of Life, Safety Stock, Average Selling Price, Slow-moving and Obsolete inventory, Purchase Order, Purchase Requisition, Stock Transfer Order, Planned Order,

| Abbreviation | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| NPI | New Product Introduction |
| EOL | End Of Life |
| ASP | Average Selling Price |
| SS | Safety Stock |
| DP | Demand Planning |
| SP | Supply Planning |
| IP | Inventory Planning |
| S&OP | Sales & Operations Planning |
| E2E | End to End |
| FI | Forecast Item |
| CTP | Capable-To-Promise |
| FLP | Full Level Pegging |
| WO | Work Order |
| PO | Purchase Order |
| PReq | Purchase Requisition |

| PLO | Planned Order |
| SLOBS | Slow-moving and Obsolete inventory |
